correctness.rationale: A fixed diagonal splits independent Catalan triangulations C_a C_b. Original ear tips are nonendpoint boundary-arc vertices; j simultaneous tips are nonadjacent subsets of a path, counted by binom(r-j+1,j), and deletion leaves C_(r-j) triangulations. Hence H_r factorial moments and the conditional product follow. Unconditional tips are nonadjacent subsets on a cycle; one-point ratio p_r=(r+1)/(2(2r-1)) gives the rational Δ numerator 2n²+n−1−(n+7)ab. For a=1 its numerator (n−2)(n−3); for a,b≥2 use ab≥2(n−2) to get negativity for n≥4. n=2,3 are zero; octagon probabilities (16,16,1)/33 vs (16,8,1)/25 on E=2,3,4 exhibit crossing tails. Independently generated exact triangulations for polygons n=2..7 and compared every fixed diagonal conditional law and sign; combinatorial proof supplies all n.
